relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that TRPV1 and NK1-expressing second-order neurons contribute to spontaneous and bite-evoked pain during masseter inflammation and muscle pain.

key_findings: Review: TRPV1, TRPA1 and TRPV4 antagonists or knockout reduce nociception in preclinical muscle hyperalgesia models.
TRPV1 is expressed in muscle afferents, many CGRP-positive, and mediates acid-induced muscle hyperalgesia.
